title: 第21章 显露真容第22章 欲加之罪
lines: “什么事情，你们无需知道！
现在，把你们的储物袋和储物戒指里的东西都拿出来吧。
记住，我说的是所有的人，也包括三大宗门的弟子。”
哗！
吴老鬼此话一出，瞬间就引起了一片骚动。
“这，诸位长老，这，不好吧？”
“对啊，进入这里之前已经说好了，收取宝物各凭本事，难道诸位长老要反悔吗？”
“是啊！
三大宗门不能这么出尔反尔。”
很显然，三大宗门长老的举动，瞬间就引起了众多势力弟子的不满。
“谁要是不满，站出来，本座会给他一个满意的交代！”
吴老鬼扫视了一番。
“我，我绝对不会……”
一名二流弟子话还没有说完，一道流光降落，将他轰成了渣渣。
“谁还有意见？”
吴老鬼淡淡说道。
“不愧是三大宗门，果然强势霸道！”
楚峰不由得暗自心惊。
“谁还有意见？”
吴老鬼淡淡说道。
仿佛那人不是他杀的一样。
大殿内沉寂了下来，几乎所有人的脸色都难看到了极点。
但是，面对着六位元海境九重的长老，他们岂敢反抗？
“不愧是三大宗门，果然霸道！”
楚峰再次见识到了三大宗门的狠辣之处。
“既然都没意见，那就从三大宗门开始吧！”
三大宗门弟子，你看看我，我看看你，最后开始纷纷拿出各自的储物袋，将里面的东西都倒了出来。
楚峰也象征性的倒出了储物袋里的东西。
六位长老精神力扫视，并未发现任何的异常。
“好了，你们将东西都收进去吧！”
三大宗门弟子也都松了一口气，纷纷收回各自的储物袋。
“到你们了！”
吴老鬼看向剩下的那些二流，三流宗门的弟子。
那些宗门弟子，哪里敢反抗，乖乖的倒出了储物袋里的东西。
content_en:
"You don't need to know anything!
Now, take out the contents of your storage bags and storage rings.
Remember, I am talking about everyone, including the disciples of the three major sects. "
Wow!
As soon as Wu Laogui said these words, he immediately caused a commotion.
"This, elders, is this not good?"
"That's right, I made an agreement before entering here that everyone should collect treasures according to their abilities. Do you elders want to go back on your word?"
"Yeah!
The three major sects cannot go back on their word like this. "
"..."
Obviously, the actions of the elders of the three major sects instantly aroused the dissatisfaction of many powerful disciples.
"If anyone is dissatisfied, please stand up and I will give him a satisfactory explanation!"
Old Ghost Wu glanced around.
"I, I will never..."
Before a second-rate disciple could finish speaking, a stream of light descended and blasted him into pieces.
"Who has any other opinions?"
Wu Laogui said calmly.
"As expected of the three major sects, they are indeed powerful and domineering!"
Chu Feng couldn't help but be secretly shocked.
"Who has any other opinions?"
Wu Laogui said calmly.
It was as if he hadn't killed that person.
The hall fell silent, and almost everyone looked extremely sad.
However, facing six elders of the ninth level of Yuanhai Realm, how could they dare to resist?
"As expected of the three major sects, they are indeed domineering!"
Chu Feng once again saw the ruthlessness of the three major sects.
"Since we all have no objections, let's start with the three major sects!"
The three major sect disciples looked at me and I looked at you. Finally, they all began to take out their storage bags and pour out the contents.
Chu Feng also symbolically poured out the contents of the storage bag.
The six elders scanned with their mental power and found nothing unusual.
"Okay, you can put everything in!"
The disciples of the three major sects also breathed a sigh of relief and took back their storage bags.
"It's your turn!"
Wu Laogui looked at the remaining disciples of the second- and third-rate sects.
Those sect disciples didn't dare to resist, so they obediently poured out the contents of their storage bags.
